key.name: monitor-sinks
key.description: Maps a stable monitor id (connector|vendor|product|serial) to a PipeWire sink node name. Monitors missing from this map are left alone.

key.name: identify-request
key.description: Monitor id to label on screen ('*' for all), plus a counter so repeated requests fire.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Log routing decisions with console.debug. Read with: journalctl -f -o cat /usr/bin/gnome-shell
